prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this firm now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn, in which our client was struck by another vehicle and sustained injuries. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, must be directed to this office and not to our client. Please do not contact our client directly for any reason.

We request that you provide the complete liability policy limits applicable to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with written confirmation of the limits within the time allowed by law. We also ask that you identify the claims representative assigned to this file.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice of the duty to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and any other materials that may bear on how the collision occurred or the extent of our client's damages.
